title: Is this a fox?
text: Bobby: I can dance for you, Grandpa.
Bobby: Grandpa, I can draw a picture for you.
Grandpa: Er, is this a fox?
Grandpa: Thank you, Bobby. I love you.
Bobby: I love you too, Grandpa.
What can Bobby do for his grandpa?
